title: CORS & Cross-Origin Requests
description: Enable and configure Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) in ASP.NET Core applications.
longDescription: This module explains Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) and how to enable it in ASP.NET Core applications. You will learn about the same-origin policy, how to configure CORS policies, and how to apply them globally or per endpoint.
whatYouLearn: Understand the same-origin policy and why CORS is needed
Configure CORS policies with allowed origins, methods, and headers
Apply CORS globally or per controller/endpoint
